description: This file contains the implementation of the ElasticsearchIndexManager class, which manages Elasticsearch index creation, deletion, rebuilding, and searching within the OrchardCore project. It includes methods for handling index settings, analysis configurations, and search responses, specifically tailored for integration with OrchardCore's indexing and search infrastructure.

classes.name: ElasticsearchIndexManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing Elasticsearch indices, including creation, deletion, rebuilding, and searching, with support for index settings, analysis, and metadata.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new Elasticsearch index with specified settings and mappings if it does not already exist.

methods.name: GetIndexSettingsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the settings of a specified Elasticsearch index.

methods.name: GetIndexInfoAsync
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specified Elasticsearch index.

methods.name: RebuildAsync
methods.description: Rebuilds an Elasticsearch index by deleting and recreating it.

methods.name: ExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks if a specified index exists in Elasticsearch.

methods.name: SearchAsync
methods.description: Performs a search on an index based on the provided search context.

methods.name: SearchAsync
methods.description: Performs a search on an index using a Fluent DSL query.

methods.name: SearchAsync
methods.description: Performs a search on an index with a raw query string.

methods.name: GetCreateIndexRequest
methods.description: Constructs a CreateIndexRequest with analysis and mapping settings based on the index profile.

methods.name: GetAnalyzer
methods.description: Creates an analyzer instance from JSON properties based on the analyzer type.

methods.name: ProcessSuccessfulSearchResponse
methods.description: Processes a successful search response, populating the ElasticsearchResult object.

methods.name: RemoveTypeNode
methods.description: Removes the 'type' property from analyzer JSON configuration.
